title: cmd (platform → server, reliable)
description: Admin command (§7.4); exactly one cmd.result each (`ref` = this id). fleet.so runs plugins.set, whitelist.set, practice.set and say itself; the rest need the match plugin (`rejected unsupported` without it). Match commands (pause, unpause, force_ready, start, restore_round, restart_map, end_match, change_map, swap_teams) need match_id + epoch (envelope or payload) of the active assignment. `restart_round` is an alias of restore_round and `end` of end_match. args: pause {type: admin|technical}; force_ready {team?}; restore_round {map_number, round, backup?: InlineBackup (single part)}; end_match {reason, winner?: team1|team2}; change_map {map_number} | {name, workshop_id?}; kick {steamid64, message?}; say {text (≤190 bytes), as_admin?}; plugins.set {enable?: [name], disable?: [name]} (not fleet; remembered across restarts); whitelist.set {enabled, steamids?: [SteamID64 string]} (needs whitelist.so); practice.set {on?, always?} (needs practice.so; on is refused while a match is loaded; always = dedicated practice server, stored on the server); settings.set {settings?: {<setting>: boolean|number|string}}: server settings of the match plugin, all or none, output = every setting after the change; exec {command}: root only (issued_by.root), one line ≤ 512 bytes, no fleet commands; output = console log lines seen within 0.5 s (≤ 8 KiB). The platform writes the audit row before sending and passes its id in audit_id; the server logs it and echoes it in cmd.result.

expires_at.description: unix ms; 0 = never. Past: cmd.result expired, not run
